## What you should be able to do tonight

- Recommend which components to run, at what capital, with what expected performance and what drawdown.
- Name what you would not run and give the reason for each.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Write the recommendation with numbers rather than adjectives: which signals, at what combined capital, at what Kelly fraction from day 129, with the resulting expected performance stated as an interval and the 95th percentile drawdown you are accepting. Include the capacity constraint from milestone 9 and say which constraint binds first.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Write the exclusions, which are more informative: the signals whose net performance did not clear the noise floor, the ones whose capacity is below the cost of running them, and the machine learning layer if the audit did not justify it. One line of reason each, and no hedging about revisiting them later.
:::
:::

::: {.project}
The dossier gains a recommendation section: which components to run, at what capital and Kelly fraction, with the expected interval and accepted drawdown, and an explicit list of what is excluded and why.
